title: Minimax games for quantum channel discrimination
summary: Quantum channel discrimination is a primitive task for identifying, verifying, and benchmarking quantum dynamics. Previous studies have primarily considered either the best-case tester-input setting or the worst-case jammer-input setting. Here, we introduce a game-theoretic framework in which both the tester and jammer control separate inputs.
